TS051 pointer-depth

A pointer points at a value rather than at another pointer, so every access is one dereference a reader can follow.

languages: go odin rust zig
severity: warning
default: opt-in
group: stable
javascript: JavaScript has no pointer type; every name binds a reference the runtime owns
python: Python has no pointer type; every name binds a reference the runtime owns
typescript: TypeScript has no pointer type; every name binds a reference the runtime owns

NASA P10 Rule 9: "The use of pointers should be restricted. Specifically, no more than one level of dereferencing is allowed."
